# Inbound wire captures

Record captured inbound `UserMessage` requests here, one directory per capture,
following [docs/receiving-fixtures.md](../../../docs/receiving-fixtures.md):

```
test/fixtures/inbound/<name>/
  request.bin             # complete transfer-decoded request body, unedited
  metadata.json           # origin, sender/version, expectations
  receiver-cert.pem       # captured receiver AP certificate (test-only)
  receiver-key.pem        # its private key, for decryption (test-only throwaway)
  trust-roots.pem         # trust anchor(s) for the sender's signing certificate
  trust-intermediates.pem # intermediate CA certificate(s)
```

`test/receiving-captures.test.ts` verifies every capture through
`openAs4Message` (verify, decrypt, payload-hash and reference comparison) and
skips while this directory holds no captures. Use synthetic documents and test
credentials only — never production material.

`metadata.json` must set `"origin": "independent"` for a real peer capture or
`"origin": "local"` for one generated by this project. `npm run validate:receive`
(the Phase 6 gate) fails unless at least two **independent** captures are present.
